intro.fresh: Let's take the first step together. We don't collect your answers — they're saved only in this app.
intro.saved_one: You have {{count}} saved medicine. Here is what could help next.
intro.saved_other: You have {{count}} saved medicines. Here is what could help next.

steps.title: Things you can do next
steps.hint: Start with number 1. Each step opens the place where you can do it.

finishScreener.title: Answer a few questions about your coverage
finishScreener.body: Your answers help us show programs that may help you pay. We don't collect them.

checkMedicare.title: Look into Medicare
checkMedicare.body: You said you are 65 or older. Medicare may help pay for medicines, and free counselors can help you choose.

findMedicine.title: Look up your first medicine
findMedicine.body: See listed prices and programs that may help.

callProgram.title: Call {{program}}
callProgram.body: This program may help pay for {{medicine}}. A short checklist helps you get ready.

renew.title: Renew {{program}} by {{date}}
renew.overdue: This date has passed. Call the program to ask what to do.

trackApplication.title: Keep your {{program}} application moving
trackApplication.body: Check your papers, notes and next step.

empty.title: You're all caught up
empty.body: Nothing needs you right now. You can look up another medicine any time.

changes.title: Changes since your last visit
changes.note: Only listed checkout prices are compared.

saved.title: Saved medicines
saved.missing: No longer in our list — search again

freshness.title: How fresh is this information?
freshness.statusDraft: Preview: some facts are not confirmed yet
freshness.statusRelease: All facts confirmed on official sources

startOver.title: Start over?
startOver.body: This clears your answers, saved medicines and applications on this phone. Your settings stay the same.

notFound.title: We can't find this page
notFound.body: The link may be old or typed wrong. Nothing you saved was changed.
